mapper.sql: u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.org_id AS orgId, o.org_name AS orgName, u.dept_id AS deptId, d.dept_name AS deptName, u.phone AS phone, u.email AS email, u.status AS status, u.last_login_at AS lastLoginAt, u.created_at AS createdAt
FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_org o ON o.id = u.org_id LEFT JOIN sys_department d ON d.id = u.dept_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, real_name, org_id, dept_id, phone, email, status, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT DISTINCT r.role_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.role_code ASC

SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.status = 1 INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.perm_code ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET last_login_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
